heading: About
subheading: A GST-verified solar EPC company specialising in residential, commercial, and agricultural solar power solutions across Aligarh district, Uttar Pradesh.
overviewParagraphs: Greentech Energy Solution is a verified wholesaler, dealer, and EPC contractor delivering rooftop solar, agricultural solar pumping, and power backup solutions. Established in 2020 and led by Director Mohd Shakir, we've grown to 1,442 kWp installed across 431+ installations, with an annual turnover of ₹51 Lakh – ₹1 Crore.

As an MNRE & UPNEDA empanelled vendor, we follow strict engineering, safety, and compliance standards on every installation. Our approach is built on transparent, customisable pricing and dependable delivery — not the lowest-quote race that leaves customers with subsidy rejections and undersized systems.
